info.name: Nextdoor Autumn Ember
info.description:
Requires Nextdoor webpage settings to be set to Dark Mode. 

Bring a cozy autumn atmosphere to Nextdoor with warm charcoal and cocoa panels,
soft cream text, golden amber links, burnt-orange buttons, copper hover accents,
and dusty-plum focus outlines. Based on Nextdoor's native dark-mode component
color rules, Autumn Ember adds a seasonal palette while keeping its familiar layout.
Independent community theme; not affiliated with Nextdoor.
